answer: Reaching the orchard of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The delta is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the raven. The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, capped per identity per epoch, no identity may audit its own recruit. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short.
